summary: Frontend + light API E2E of SaloneHCM Training infrastructure (iter33). Verified public Training Center page (/training), all 4 tabs (articles/faq/quizzes/downloads), full quiz pass+fail flow with certificate PDF issuance, 7 role-based training videos on /videos, marketing nav 'Training' link, Feature Directory 'Open the Training Center' link post-login, and smoke of Payroll/Vouchers/Landing pages. All specified flows PASS. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: TrainingCenterPage.jsx: quiz answer keys are correctly server-side only — GET /api/public/training/content returns no 'answer'/'correct' fields in questions (verified programmatically across all 6 quizzes).
Quiz submit button gating is correct: disabled until ALL questions answered AND name.trim().length >= 2. Verified with vouchers quiz (name empty → disabled; all answers + name → enabled).
Certificate download link renders ONLY on pass (result.passed && result.certificate_id); FAIL case shows retry button and no cert link — verified.
MarketingNav.jsx has 'Training' link (data-testid=nav-training) in both desktop and mobile drawers pointing to /training — good coverage.
Downloads tab groups by kind (Reference card / Checklist / Scripts / Presentation) — renders 11 items correctly (6 QRC PDFs + 1 checklist + 1 scripts + 3 PPTX decks).

success_rate.backend: 100% (all curl-verified: /api/public/training/content, /api/static/training/*.mp4 x7, /api/static/training/*.jpg x2, /api/static/training/docs/*.pdf|.pptx x5, cert PDF, cert verify known+unknown, /api/marketing/videos)

test_credentials: admin@gov.sl / GovAdmin@2026 (worked). Public /training and /videos require no auth.
